name: Jorge-Meeks k-noid

definition.note: No closed form is stored for this surface. It is defined by its shipped implementation in math_art.minsurf.parametric, which is authoritative; an unverified transcription would silently define a different surface.

provenance.definition: Derived from the Math Art generator registries and cross-referenced to the literature; not transcribed from any gallery's compilation.
sources: L. P. Jorge and W. H. Meeks III, 'The topology of complete minimal surfaces of finite total Gaussian curvature', Topology 22 (1983).

L. P. Jorge, W. H. Meeks III, 'The topology of complete minimal surfaces of finite total Gaussian curvature', Topology 22 (1983) 203-221; M. Weber (mirror: minsurf ch222): 'A k-Noid is a minimal surface with k catenoidal ends.'

cross_checked.detail: page title 'Trinoid' vs record name 'Jorge-Meeks k-noid'

discovered_by: Luquesio Jorge and William Meeks III

caveats: k catenoidal ends in symmetric position; k = 2 degenerates to the catenoid. Which k give EMBEDDED surfaces is not asserted here.
